howToPlay: Grom is an artillery brawler who excels at attacking from behind walls. Use his cross-shaped attack to zone enemies and deploy his Super to break obstacles while pushing back opponents. Combine his long-range attacks with gadgets and star powers to control the battlefield.
gears: Damage is essential for increasing his explosive impact, while Shield helps compensate for his health. Speed is also a solid choice to help him navigate the map quickly while his Super is charged.
trait: This brawler suits players who prefer calculating shots and maintaining distance from enemies.
